title: The uncle wants one framed
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The uncle, without preamble, hands Wood a napkin and says frame it. A walrus. Gully's. Gully is out on the skiff. The uncle says don't tell him. Wood takes it to the shop Tuesday in his coat pocket with the misfold, the note, the pulled strip. The pocket has a walrus now.

panels.composition: The chair. The UNCLE holding out a folded napkin without looking at WOOD. The skiff far out on the bay with GULLY in it, a speck.

image.prompt: an old man in a lawn chair holding out a folded paper napkin to a young man without looking at him, a distant skiff on the bay behind, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The napkin: a walrus, the first one, 1998's line — no. This year's. The walrus in the crown.
